decision: Make the manual production deployment's unauthenticated author-application route verification resilient to transient edge/network failures while retaining an exact HTTP 401 security requirement.
invariants: Production deployment remains manual and requires confirm_production_deploy=true.
The protected author-application endpoint must return exactly HTTP 401 when no session is supplied.
Retries are bounded to five attempts and do not treat any non-401 response as success.
No Cloudflare credentials, secrets, D1 schema, migration, Worker runtime, user data or production state is changed.
This change does not dispatch or trigger a production deployment.
acceptance: Production deploy gate test requires the five-attempt retry loop and exact 401 condition.
Cloudflare source validation and migration governance pass.
The deployment workflow continues to run only from workflow_dispatch with explicit true confirmation.
Per-attempt HTTP status is emitted for diagnosis and the check fails after the bounded retry window if 401 is not observed.
releaseBoundary: CI reliability only; no production deployment or authorization-policy change.
